description: This file defines a React functional component called Navbar that provides the top navigation bar for a mechanic portal application, including links, user status display, and logout functionality.

methods.name: statusChipText(mechanicStatus, user)
methods.description: Computes the display text for the mechanic's status chip based on mechanicStatus and user object, supporting both Supabase and mock modes.

methods.name: Navbar({ user, mechanicStatus })
methods.description: React functional component that renders the navigation bar, shows links based on user login state, displays mechanic status, and handles logout logic.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function invoked to log the user out, supporting both Supabase sign-out with redirect and fallback to dataService logout.
